title: Card: link the free API at decision.vllm-sr.ai and the official Space
Runtime: loading checks only the files the runtime reads
Card: Engine mode batches by default; engine arguments replace runtime profiles
message: Names the two measured Engine mode setups for what they were: one request per forward, the former default (exact in the chart), and batching, the default in vLLM Semantic Router from main. The engine arguments --max-num-batched-tokens, --max-num-seqs, --batch-window-ms and --dtype replace the --runtime-profile flag. README.md only; every measured number is unchanged.

title: Card: LiquidAI d1-omni-600M on the public vision suite (our run)
Card: official Jev Decision Index 0.3.2 results and serving performance
Runtime: faster System One server replies
Card: shorter vLLM Semantic Router command
message: The "Run with vLLM Semantic Router" section now uses `vllm-sr serve -e vllm-sr/d3-edge`: the platform is detected automatically, and one line lists the `--platform` values (auto, cpu, cuda, rocm; default auto). The parity sentence keeps its measurement context (AMD Instinct MI325X). MODEL_MANIFEST.json records the new README.md (SHA-256 and size) in the same commit. Weights, runtime files and the v3.1.0 tag are unchanged.

title: Card: run with vLLM Semantic Router (Engine mode)
message: Adds the "Run with vLLM Semantic Router" section: install the vllm-sr CLI from the development channel, `vllm-sr serve vllm-sr/d3-edge --engine --platform rocm`, and text, image and video requests to the System One API. MODEL_MANIFEST.json records the new README.md (SHA-256 and size) in the same commit. Weights, runtime files and the v3.1.0 tag are unchanged.
